tools.name: score_email
tools.description: Decide what to do with one lead email: action keep / fix (with the corrected address in send_to) / review / drop, plus a plain-English action_reason. Also returns verdict business / free / role / disposable / risky / invalid / unknown, a 0-100 score, reasons, MX + mail provider, typo suggestion (gmi

tools.name: score_domain
tools.description: Check a company domain (or URL / email): MX records, mail provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, ...), free/disposable flags, and SPF/DMARC. Useful before outreach or when qualifying a lead's company.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: score_domain · Private data: score_domain · Public sink: score_email, score_domain · Destructive: score_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: score_domain · Private data: score_domain · Public sink: score_email, score_domain · Destructive: score_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
